name: Rizuhble's Power Outage Seven
point_model: claims about ability tiers require model A and model B to agree

items.name: Extra Regen
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Temporary: sell it later, once you're out of slots.
items.legacy_note: Sell it once you're out of slots.

sections.label: Early game
sections.desc: Souls 0-7,200 (levels 1-13). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Static Charge T1, Storm Cloud T2. Ultimate (Storm Cloud) is available from Cultist Sacrifice.

items.name: Monster Rounds
items.why: weapon investment only and the build never reaches the 4.8k weapon tier through the core: timing review

items.name: Extra Spirit
items.why: spirit investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Mystic Vulnerability, 12000 souls (~12.0 min) later and spirit is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Extra Stamina
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k vitality tier, which Healbane completes 8,800 souls on.
items.why: on the path to the build's first 4.8k (vitality): Healbane completes 4.8k vitality in 8800 souls (~8.8 min), 5 purchases

items.name: Surge of Power
items.caption: Imbued on Power Surge: +28 spirit on that ability only, about +15.4 on its bonus per chain (0.55x scaling). Upgrade of Extra Spirit (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Cultist Sacrifice
items.why: weapon investment only and the build never reaches the 4.8k weapon tier through the core: timing review

sections.label: Midgame
sections.desc: Souls 7,200-17,600 (levels 13-24). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Power Surge T3, Storm Cloud T3. Your biggest single spirit hit (Static Charge, damage) grows from 60.5 to 107. 4.8k spikes: vitality 4.8k at Healbane, spirit 4.8k at Mystic Vulnerability.

items.name: Spirit Lifesteal
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k vitality tier, which Healbane completes 2,400 souls on.
items.why: imminent: Healbane completes 4.8k vitality in 2400 souls (~2.4 min), 2 purchases

items.name: Sprint Boots
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k vitality tier, which Healbane completes 1,600 souls on.
items.why: imminent: Healbane completes 4.8k vitality in 1600 souls (~1.6 min), 1 purchases

items.name: Healbane
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k vitality tier (3,200 to 4,800 invested): bonus 20 to 38 vitality bonus.

items.name: Enduring Speed
items.why: vitality investment only; its 6.4k tier completes at Unstoppable, 19200 souls (~19.2 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Mystic Vulnerability
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k spirit tier (3,200 to 4,800 invested): bonus 19 to 38 spirit power.

items.name: Duration Extender
items.caption: Imbued on Storm Cloud: its duration-scaled parts (channel time 14s) get +22%. Takes spirit from 4,800 to 6,400 invested: bonus 38 to 45 spirit power.

items.name: Compress Cooldown
items.caption: Imbued on Power Surge: takes 18% off its 32s base cooldown. Takes spirit from 6,400 to 8,000 invested: bonus 45 to 52 spirit power.

items.name: Mystic Expansion
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Imbued on Storm Cloud: widens its radius and range (initial radius, lightning strike radius).

sections.label: Late game
sections.desc: Souls 17,600-46,400 (levels 24-35). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Lightning Ball T3. Your biggest single spirit hit (Static Charge, damage) grows from 107 to 159.

items.name: Arcane Surge
items.caption: +20 spirit adds about 15.8 to Static Charge's damage (0.79x scaling), your steepest spirit scaling. Upgrade of Extra Stamina (already owned): costs 800 souls more, not 1,600.
items.legacy_note: Dash-jump right before you pop your 3, or your ult once you have it.

items.name: Escalating Exposure
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 10,400 to 15,200 invested: bonus 52 to 59 spirit power.

items.name: Superior Duration
items.caption: +28% to every duration-scaled effect you have: Storm Cloud channel time (14s), Power Surge duration (20s), Power Surge damage per chain (18s). Takes spirit from 15,200 to 16,800 invested: bonus 59 to 66 spirit power. Upgrade of Duration Extender (already owned): costs 1,600 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Unstoppable
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 4,800 to 11,200 invested, crossing the 6.4k, 8k, 11.2k tiers: bonus 38 to 50 vitality bonus.
items.legacy_note: Pop it before you ult so nobody cancels the storm.

items.name: Superior Cooldown
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: With 4 abilities trained their base cooldowns total 285s; 20% off is 57s per full rotation.

items.name: Infuser
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 11,200 to 16,000 invested: bonus 50 to 54 vitality bonus.
items.legacy_note: Pop it once they're all in the storm.

items.name: Greater Expansion
items.caption: +30% range and radius on everything that scales with them: Storm Cloud radius (40m), Storm Cloud initial radius (15m), Storm Cloud lightning strike radius (7m). Upgrade of Mystic Expansion (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Diviner's Kevlar
items.caption: Casting Storm Cloud gives a 1,000 barrier and +40 spirit for 20s, available once per ultimate cooldown (205s at your current ultimate tier), so it is a once-per-fight burst of defence. Takes vitality from 16,000 to 22,400 invested: bonus 54 to 60 vitality bonus.

sections.label: Situational counters
sections.legacy_desc: Dying after Enduring Speed? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Healbane.
sections.desc: Dying after Enduring Speed? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Healbane.

items.name: Metal Skin
items.caption: Immune to bullets only, for 5s on a 24s cooldown, at 1.5m/s slower: buy it against one gun carry, not against ability damage.
items.legacy_note: One gun hero is deleting you: Haze, Wraith, Vindicta.

items.name: Plated Armor
items.caption: Passive: 30% chance to deflect a bullet and 50% to block its on-hit effects; it helps against several gun heroes at once where a timed bullet immunity covers only one.
items.legacy_note: Most of their damage is gun and Metal Skin isn't enough.

items.name: Counterspell
items.caption: Your next parry blocks an enemy ability's damage and effects (0.8s window, 23s cooldown), so it only answers an ability you can see coming.
items.legacy_note: A big ability you can see coming at you, like Lash's ult or Grey Talon's charged arrow.

items.name: Dispel Magic
items.caption: Purges non-ultimate debuffs (silence, slow, disarm) and heals 250, but cannot be used while stunned or asleep, so it answers a hex or silence and not a stun already on you.
items.legacy_note: They hit you with Knockdown, Slowing Hex or Toxic Bullets.

items.name: Spirit Resilience
items.caption: Spirit resist 30, plus 15 more below 50% health: buy it when enemy spirit damage is what kills you.
items.legacy_note: Most of their damage is spirit: Infernus, Kelvin, Geist, Vyper.

items.name: Spirit Burn
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 20,800 to 27,200 invested: bonus 66 to 75 spirit power.

items.name: Boundless Spirit
items.caption: +30 spirit adds about 23.8 to Static Charge's damage (0.79x scaling), your steepest spirit scaling. Takes spirit from 20,800 to 27,200 invested: bonus 66 to 75 spirit power. Replaces Cultist Sacrifice: sell it when you buy this (all 12 slots are full).

items.name: Lightning Scroll
items.caption: Storm Cloud deals damage (damage per second, lightning strike damage), so it applies the item's 0.75s stun after a 3s delay plus 150 damage. Takes spirit from 20,800 to 25,600 invested: bonus 66 to 75 spirit power. Replaces Arcane Surge: sell it when you buy this (all 12 slots are full).

items.name: Divine Barrier
items.caption: Cast on yourself or an ally: removes non-stun debuffs and gives a 600 barrier for 6s, 45s cooldown (halved when cast on an ally), so it covers debuffs and burst damage but not a stun.
items.legacy_note: If you bought Dispel Magic, sell it for this. Otherwise sell Surge of Power.

items.name: Refresher
items.caption: Resets every ability and charge: up to 285s of base cooldown across your kit, 205s of it the ultimate; the item has its own cooldown of 300s. Takes spirit from 20,800 to 27,200 invested: bonus 66 to 75 spirit power. Replaces Infuser: sell it when you buy this (all 12 slots are full).

items.name: Transcendent Cooldown
items.caption: Same-slot upgrade of Superior Cooldown for 3,200 more souls: item cooldown reduction 0 to 25; cooldown reduction 20 to 25..

items.name: Juggernaut
items.caption: Same-slot upgrade of Enduring Speed for 4,800 more souls: fire rate slow 0 to 40; slow resistance percent 25 to 50..

sections.label: Losing lane (temporary)
sections.legacy_desc: Get Mystic Vulnerability before Cultist Sacrifice and the green items, then carry on.
sections.desc: Get Mystic Vulnerability before Cultist Sacrifice and the green items, then carry on.
